resources.string: This activity has been submitted and can no longer be changed. An administrator can still correct it.
Optional date shown on the certificate, for example the examination date.
Only the activities of #VAR1# are shown.
The requirement period each contribution is credited to. Defaults to the activity begin date.
Tracks member activities and recurring training, certification, continuing-education, and similar requirements.
Members may always edit and delete their own activities
Controls whether submitting an activity locks it against later member changes. Administrators can still review and correct records.
Members may edit and delete only draft activities
Allowed file types: #VAR1#. At most #VAR2# MiB per file and #VAR3# files per activity.

Comma-separated list of the file types members may attach, for example "pdf,jpg,png". Leave empty to allow every supported type. Only pdf, jpg and png can be stored; anything else in the list is ignored.
Certificate files are switched off for this organization.

Members may attach the certificate they received to an activity, so that a reviewer can check the claim against the evidence. The files are stored outside the web directory and are only ever readable by the member the activity belongs to and by the requirements administrators.
How many files may be attached to one activity.
The size limit of a single file. The server upload limit still applies and may be lower.
No certificate has been attached to this activity yet.
The certificate storage of this organization is full (#VAR1#). Delete some files or raise the quota.
The activity was saved, but the file was not attached: #VAR1#
This activity already has the maximum of #VAR1# files.
The total size of all certificates of this organization. 0 means no limit.
A file of type #VAR1# cannot be attached. Allowed are: #VAR2#.
The file type could not be determined, so the file was not accepted. The PHP extension "fileinfo" has to be installed for certificate uploads.
If selected, no begin or end time is stored for this activity.

To import certificates as well, upload a ZIP file containing the spreadsheet and the certificate files. The "certificates" column names the files of each activity, separated by semicolons - by their file name or by their path inside the ZIP file.
The ZIP file contains no spreadsheet (CSV, XLSX, XLS or ODS).
The ZIP file contains more than one spreadsheet. It must contain exactly one.
The ZIP file is too large: it may hold at most 1000 files and unpack to at most 256 MB.
The ZIP file could not be read.
The ZIP file contains the entry "#VAR1#", which points outside the archive.
Certificates are switched off for this organization; the files named in this row are not attached.
The certificates named in this row are not attached: upload a ZIP file with the spreadsheet and the certificates to import them as well.
Several files in the ZIP file are called "#VAR1#". Name it by its path inside the ZIP file.
The certificate "#VAR1#" is not in the ZIP file.
A credit column adds a contribution for that requirement. The period column beside it is optional; without it the contribution is credited to the period the activity falls in.

Import activities and their credits from a CSV or spreadsheet file. Nothing is written until you have seen the preview and confirmed it. Columns whose heading is one of the following names are assigned automatically:

An activity counts as already existing when the same member has one with the same title and begin date, or one with the same source key. There is no default: whether a repeated row is a correction or a second attendance is a decision only you can make.
With headings, columns whose heading is a known field name are assigned automatically. Without them, every column has to be assigned by hand.
Assign exactly one of these columns. A name needs both halves, and a name that several members of this organization share is reported instead of being guessed.

Identify the member by a profile field, for example the membership number. Choose the field here and the column holding it below. A column headed profile_ followed by the internal name of the field, for example profile_membership_number, is assigned automatically.
To identify the member by a profile field, choose both the profile field and its column.
The first rows of the file
#VAR1# rows read: #VAR2# would be imported, #VAR3# skipped, #VAR4# with errors.
#VAR1# rows read: #VAR2# imported, #VAR3# skipped, #VAR4# with errors.
#VAR1# of #VAR2# rows are shown: those with errors first, then the skipped ones.
Name or number of the worksheet to import. Leave empty for the first one. Ignored for a CSV file.
The activity end date must not be before its begin date.
The rule validity end date must not be before its start date.
Member on the first day of the period
If enabled, the obligation only arises when the user was a member of the role on the first day of the requirement period.
How the obligations of several qualifying roles are combined for one member.
No role rules defined for this requirement type yet.
What the organization asks of you through your current roles.
No requirement is assigned to your current roles.
Number of periods before the running one shown in the fulfilment overview above the activity list. The unit follows each requirement (year, quarter, month or week).
You have not defined any requirements of your own yet.

Requirements you track for yourself in addition to those of the organization, for example the training obligations of your employer or of a licence, and your own targets for requirements of the organization that apply to you through your work. Other members do not see them. The administrators of the organization see them on your activities and in the change history, which keeps a record of your changes to them as well. Credit your activities to them like to any other requirement.
The day your obligation begins. Nothing is owed for the periods before it, and the period it falls into is pro-rated when partial periods are pro-rated.
Set own target for a requirement

A requirement of the organization that applies to you through your work rather than through one of your roles, for example the IDD hours of your employer. Your target is combined with any role rule of the requirement as if it were one more role.

A requirement can only be part of a requirement that is not itself a part of another one. A requirement of the organization can only be part of another one of the organization; a personal requirement can be part of an organization requirement that applies to you or of another of your own. A requirement that has parts cannot become a part.
Sub-requirements are only possible for requirements with a calendar period. A requirement renewed after its last fulfilment has no periods that a part could share.

A sub-requirement is a part of another requirement, for example "in person" hours of a continuing-education requirement. Its credits are entered as "thereof" under the credits of the parent on the same activity, in the same period, and can never exceed them - also not the accepted ones. It takes over the period of its parent, which needs a calendar period, and has role rules of its own. Credits entered before the requirement became a part stay as they are.
Full amount regardless of partial membership
Pro rata to the qualifying membership
Number of period units. Calendar periods currently support the value 1 only.
Selects the default granularity for newly created pro-rata role rules. The chosen value is stored on each rule so later setting changes do not reinterpret historical rules.
Pick this entry and save to create a provider now; you return to this activity afterwards.
A public provider is visible to every member of the organization. A private provider is visible to its creator and administrators only.
Administrators mark a provider as qualified when its training is recognised.
This provider short name is already in use in a conflicting provider scope.
Optional abbreviation used in imports and reports. Must be unique among public providers, or among your own private providers.
An inactive requirement type is no longer offered for new configuration but existing obligations keep being calculated.
This requirement type still has #VAR1# credited contributions and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead, or remove the contributions first.
This requirement still has #VAR1# sub-requirements and cannot be deleted. Delete or detach them first.
This requirement short name is already used in the current organization.
Optional abbreviation used in imports, reports and the fulfilment overview.

Who handles a review. With the configured reviewers every review goes to all of them. Otherwise whoever submits or requests a review may name one of the configured reviewers, or any member or role of the organization. The configured reviewers always see every review.
Who should handle the review. Without a choice the configured reviewers handle it.
The current members of these roles review the activities. Administrators of the plugin are not reviewers unless they are listed here.
Individual members who review the activities, in addition to the reviewer roles.

Enter the accepted credits; the status follows the amount unless you choose one. An empty amount leaves the claim undecided, an accepted zero rejects it. A clarification asks the member something and needs a comment. Each row is saved on its own.
Accept all open credits as claimed
Everything in this period has been decided already. To have it reviewed again, please give your reasons.
Cancel this review? The member is told, and decisions already made stay.
A clarification asks the member something: please write the question in the comment.
This credit is under review or has been decided on and cannot be removed.
In mode "Submission after each period": the number of days after the end of a period by which members have to submit it. 0 means no deadline.

Whether members may still change an activity once its credits have been decided. The decision stays as it is either way; changes are marked for the reviewers. Certificates can always be added. A member who wants a different decision asks for a new review.
Whether members may change an activity while one of its credits waits for a decision. If allowed, the change is marked for the reviewers. A question of the reviewer always unlocks the activity.
Switches the review of activities on. Off hides everything that has to do with reviews; every credit then counts as claimed, or with the amount a reviewer accepted earlier.
The member gets a summary of the decisions. Credits still open stay open.
This activity is under review or has been decided on and cannot be changed right now. You can still add certificates in the activity list.
the review of your activities of #VAR1# has been called off - there is nothing you need to do. #VAR2# whenever you want to look at them.
A reviewer has decided on your activities:
The review of #VAR1# of #VAR2# has been handed to a different reviewer.

just a friendly reminder: the reviewers still have a question about your activities of #VAR1#. #VAR2#, read the question, change the activities if needed and send your answer with "Answer and resubmit".
just a friendly reminder: the reviewers would like to see your activities of #VAR1#. #VAR2#, add anything that is still missing and choose "Share activities" - it only takes a moment.
the reviewers would like to look at your activities of #VAR1#. #VAR2#, add anything that is still missing and choose "Share activities" when you are ready.
#VAR1# asks for a new decision on #VAR2#.
#VAR1# answered the questions on #VAR2# and submitted it again.
#VAR1# shared the activities of #VAR2# for review.
just a friendly reminder: your activities of #VAR1# are still waiting to be submitted for review. #VAR2#, check that everything is complete and choose "Submit period for review".

How the credits of this requirement are reviewed. "Optional": credits count as claimed, a member may ask for a review. "Approval required, on submission": a credit counts once accepted, and the member submits activities or a period for review. "Approval required for every activity": a credit counts once accepted, and every submitted activity is reviewed. "Submission after each period": credits count as claimed, and every member the requirement applies to submits each finished period. "Audits": credits count as claimed, and only the reviewers ask members for a review. Reviewers may ask any member for a review in every mode except "No review".
Submissions after each period and audits need a requirement with calendar periods.
A part is reviewed the way the requirement it is a part of is reviewed.
Optional, on request of the member
Nothing of this activity has been decided on yet.
There is nothing to submit for review here: no credit is waiting for a submission.
Send mails to the member and the reviewers when a review is submitted, requested, shared, decided on or finished.
You cannot be the reviewer of your own submission.
Reviews can only be requested for requirements with calendar periods that are reviewed.
The member has not shared the activities yet; they are shown once shared.
The periods of this requirement are not submitted for review.
No member is concerned by this requirement in this period.
No requirement type has been configured yet, so there is nothing to review.
A partial acceptance needs the accepted amount.
Ask members to share their activities of a requirement for review. Each member gets a mail, completes their activities and shares them; you review them once they are shared.
The members asked. Leave it empty and give a sample size to draw from everybody the requirement applied to.
Please choose members, or a sample size.
The period of the date, and as many periods before it, are reviewed - one review per member and period.
Any day of the (latest) period to review.
Draw this many members at random - from the members chosen, or from everybody the requirement applied to. 0 asks the members chosen.
The decided credits of the activity are reopened for you to change, and the reviewer is asked to decide again. The earlier decision counts until then.
Change the activities as asked, then resubmit them with your answer to the reviewer.
Your activities of this requirement and period become visible to the reviewers. Complete them before you share them.
Show the activities of this member
The credits of this activity are handed to the reviewers.

Everything in this period has been decided already. Submitting it again asks the reviewers for a new decision; please explain why your activities should count differently. The earlier decision counts until then.
All your submitted activities of this requirement and period are handed to the reviewers. Complete them before you submit.
There are rows that have not been saved.
Withdraw this submission? Decisions already made stay.
This role already has an overlapping rule for the requirement. Correct the validity dates before saving.
Show the activities this period is made up of
Do you want to submit the activity "#VAR1#" for review? Depending on the organization settings you may no longer be able to change it afterwards.
The credits for "#VAR1#" cannot exceed those for "#VAR2#" on the same activity, because they are a part of them.
Credits for "#VAR1#" are part of the credits for "#VAR2#": enter those for the same period on the same activity as well.
The role "#VAR1#" has both full and pro-rata rules in this period. The higher of the two obligations is used; correct the rules.
The role "#VAR1#" has several full-amount rules in this period. The highest value is used; correct the rules.
Fulfilment overview on the overview page
Shows every member the fulfilment of their requirements as a widget on the overview page.
Number of periods before the running one that the widget on the overview page shows.
